name: muapi-music-video
tagline_zh: 给一首歌，自动拆成N个镜头，逐帧动画+配乐同步生成。不用剪辑软件，不用找素材，30秒出片。
tagline_en: Drop a song, get a music video: N keyframes, animated scenes, and synced score—no editing, no assets, 30s to.
desc_en: Build a short music video from a song theme — N keyframes, animate each, generate matching music.
why_zh: 同类工具只做画面拼接，它却把歌词情绪转成关键帧，连配乐都按节奏重写——真正从歌里长出来的MV。
why_en: Others stitch clips; this one turns lyrics into keyframes and rescores music to match—an MV born from the song itself.
